en: Black‑and‑white image of a European city street with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses. In the foreground is a large, pale, three‑storey corner building with Baroque/Neoclassical detailing, high gabled roof and a broad exterior stairway leading up from a cobbled street. Trees and a fenced garden are on the left; a long row of similar buildings continues along the street to the right. Pedestrians and children with bicycles stand on an unpaved or lightly paved roadway; a taller tower‑like building appears in the distant background along the same street. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.
